newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean rebels take town in Shaba.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels take town in Shaba.

text.p: Zairean rebels have taken the town of Kasenga, bringing them within 220 km (135 miles) of the country's second city, the copper capital Lubumbashi, expatriate and local sources said on Friday.
"It is definitely rebel troops who are in control of Kasenga," said one source with contacts in the town that lies to the south of Lake Mweru, on the border with Zambia.

The expatriates, who declined to be identified, said the Zairean army had fled south and there were wounded people in Kasenga after clashes late on Thursday, the day the rebels agreed at a summit in Togo to talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko's government.
It was unclear whether the clashes involved fighting between the two sides or looting by Zairean troops before they fled southwards towards Lubumbashi.
Zairean military sources confirmed the town's fall, according to one well-connected Lubumbashi businessman.
